title: Highest mountains
prompt: Name the 10 highest mountains on Earth

source.name: Wikipedia: List of highest mountains on Earth

fact.text: Surveyors got exactly 29,000 ft, but announced 29,002 so it wouldn't look like a rounded guess.
Aleister Crowley was part of the first serious attempt to climb it, in 1902.
In 1962 a lama led over 300 followers up its snow slopes to open the way to a legendary valley of immortality.
Its middle summit was the highest unclimbed named point on Earth until a Russian team reached it in 2001.
The area around it has been a focus for yeti expeditions.
In 2017 Valery Rozov BASE jumped off it from 7,700 metres.
Its 1960 first ascent used a plane that set the record for highest fixed-wing landing, then crashed and was abandoned.
A 2021 investigation found most climbers who claimed to have summited it never stood on the true peak.
Hermann Buhl finished the first ascent alone on a methamphetamine-based drug, then spent the night standing on a ledge.
It is named after the Hindu goddess of food, and its name can be translated as "everlasting food".
